es: Demostrar el nivel C1 en una tarea integrada: analizar un caso, negociar una solución con tacto y resumirla con matices para otro lector.

vocabulary.es: en aras de, por el bien de

teaching.en: Each resident who wants to raise a concern deserves a serious answer, so the council cannot simply go ahead with the plan.
teaching.es: Cada vecino que quiera plantear una preocupación merece una respuesta seria, así que el ayuntamiento no puede seguir adelante sin más con el plan.
teaching.explanationEs: Raise a concern = plantear una preocupación. Go ahead with = seguir adelante con algo ya previsto.
segments: Each resident who wants to raise a concern deserves a serious
answer, so the council cannot simply go ahead with the plan.
teaching.audioText: Each resident who wants to raise a concern deserves a serious answer, so the council cannot simply go ahead with the plan.

teaching.en: Before it decides, the council must weigh the options, since every outcome helps one group and worries another.
teaching.es: Antes de decidir, el ayuntamiento debe sopesar las opciones, ya que cada resultado ayuda a un grupo y preocupa a otro.
teaching.explanationEs: Weigh the options = comparar ventajas y riesgos. Outcome = resultado final de un proceso.
segments: Before it decides, the council must weigh the options,
since every outcome helps one group and worries another.
teaching.audioText: Before it decides, the council must weigh the options, since every outcome helps one group and worries another.

teaching.en: A compromise is easier to hammer out when both sides say what they need, not merely what they want.
teaching.es: Un compromiso es más fácil de cerrar cuando ambas partes dicen lo que necesitan, y no solo lo que quieren.
teaching.explanationEs: Hammer out = negociar hasta lograr un acuerdo. Necesidad frente a deseo: la base de un compromiso.
segments: A compromise is easier to hammer out when both sides
say what they need, not merely what they want.
teaching.audioText: A compromise is easier to hammer out when both sides say what they need, not merely what they want.

teaching.en: To make a concession, offer something cheap for you but valuable for them, such as ten parking spaces on the lot.
teaching.es: Para hacer una concesión, ofrece algo barato para ti pero valioso para ellos, como diez plazas de aparcamiento en el solar.
teaching.explanationEs: Make a concession = ceder algo para avanzar. Lot = solar, terreno vacío.
segments: To make a concession, offer something cheap for you but valuable
for them, such as ten parking spaces on the lot.
teaching.audioText: To make a concession, offer something cheap for you but valuable for them, such as ten parking spaces on the lot.

teaching.en: In the interests of fairness, summarise the outcome by saying who gains, who loses and what concern remains.
teaching.es: Por el bien de la imparcialidad, resume el resultado diciendo quién gana, quién pierde y qué preocupación sigue abierta.
teaching.explanationEs: In the interests of = en aras de. Summarise = resumir (no resume, que significa «reanudar»).
segments: In the interests of fairness, summarise the outcome by
saying who gains, who loses and what concern remains.
teaching.audioText: In the interests of fairness, summarise the outcome by saying who gains, who loses and what concern remains.

teaching.en: To summarise with nuance, use seem, may or appear: the outcome seems acceptable to most residents, though not to everyone.
teaching.es: Para resumir con matiz, usa seem, may o appear: el resultado parece aceptable para la mayoría de los vecinos, aunque no para todos.
teaching.explanationEs: Un resumen matizado evita «todos» y «nadie»: cuantifica y deja abierto lo que sigue pendiente.
segments: To summarise with nuance, use seem, may or appear: the
outcome seems acceptable to most residents, though not to everyone.
teaching.audioText: To summarise with nuance, use seem, may or appear: the outcome seems acceptable to most residents, though not to everyone.

prompt.es: ¿Qué describe mejor el punto de partida del caso?

choices.text: One group wants the lot, and the other opposes any change at all.
Two legitimate aims want the same space, and both groups worry about noise.
The council has chosen a car park, and residents are appealing against it.

feedback.es: Hay dos objetivos legítimos para un solo solar y una preocupación común por el ruido. Ningún grupo se opone a todo cambio, y el ayuntamiento no ha decidido nada.

hint.es: Busca lo que comparten los dos grupos además de lo que los separa.

origin.text: Case file: The empty lot on Linden Street belongs to the council. Mia's group wants a community garden. Tom's group wants a car park, because nearby shops have lost customers. Both groups have raised concerns about noise.

prompt.es: Completa: «Pasaron dos horas intentando cerrar un acuerdo aceptable para ambos.»

feedback.es: Hammer out an agreement es la colocación natural para negociar con esfuerzo hasta cerrar un acuerdo; work out y thrash out también son posibles.

hint.es: Es el verbo de golpear, usado en sentido figurado para acuerdos.

origin.text: Mia and Tom spent two hours trying to ___ out an agreement that both groups could accept. By the end, each had given up something.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Veo tu preocupación, pero lo veo de forma algo distinta.»

answer.text: I see your concern but I see it slightly differently

feedback.es: La primera parte reconoce la preocupación del otro y slightly differently discrepa con tacto, sin decir que está equivocado.

hint.es: Primero se reconoce; después se discrepa con una fórmula suave.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige cómo maneja Mia el desacuerdo con Tom.

choices.text: She concedes his point completely to keep the peace at the meeting.
She ignores his concern and repeats her original demand.
She acknowledges his concern, disagrees tactfully and offers a conditional compromise.

feedback.es: Mia reconoce, discrepa con «slightly differently» y propone un compromiso con condición (provided that). No cede del todo ni ignora a Tom.

origin.audio: At the meeting, Tom said that parking mattered more than flowers. Mia replied that she understood his concern, but that she saw it slightly differently: a garden would bring customers as well. Then she suggested a small garden on half of the lot, provided that ten parking spaces stayed. Tom hesitated, and then nodded.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase con la función que cumple en la negociación.

pairs: To summarise, the outcome seems acceptable

feedback.es: Cada frase cumple una función distinta: reconocer, discrepar con tacto, proponer con condición y resumir con matiz.

pairs: To summarise, the outcome seems acceptable

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase resume los resultados con matiz?

choices.text: The plan seems acceptable to most residents, although the noise concern remains open.
Everyone agrees that the plan is perfect and that noise is not an issue.
Six residents voted against, so the plan has clearly failed and must be dropped.

feedback.es: Usa seems y reconoce la reserva pendiente, sin generalizar. Decir que todos están de acuerdo exagera, y seis votos en contra de veintitrés no bastan para declarar un fracaso.

origin.text: Residents' meeting notes: Fourteen residents voted for the garden and car park plan, six voted against, and three did not vote. The main objection was weekend noise.

prompt.es: Redacta un resumen matizado para el ayuntamiento: condición, reserva y plazo.

answer.text: Dear Council, To summarise, the residents of Linden Street have reached a compromise about the empty lot. At first, Mia wanted a garden, whereas Tom wanted parking, but both sides have moved towards the middle. They appear to agree on a small garden on half of the lot, provided that ten parking spaces stay and the garden is open to everyone. Admittedly, one concern remains: some residents fear that weekend noise may increase. Sara has therefore asked for a review in September, and most people seem to support that idea. The shopkeepers nearby have also welcomed the plan, since more visitors should bring more customers to their street. On balance, the outcome seems acceptable to most neighbours, although it may not satisfy everyone, and nobody has claimed a clear victory over the others. We would be grateful if the council could confirm its decision by 15 June, so that work can begin before the summer. Thank you very much for your time and attention. Kind regards, The Linden Street residents

Admittedly, one concern remains: some residents fear that weekend noise may increase. Sara has therefore asked for a review in September, and most people seem to support that idea. The shopkeepers nearby have also welcomed the plan, since more visitors should bring more customers to their street. On balance, the outcome seems acceptable to most neighbours, although it may not satisfy everyone, and nobody has claimed a clear victory over the others. We would be grateful if the council could confirm its decision by 15 June, so that work can begin before the summer. Thank you very much for your time and attention. Kind regards, The Linden Street residents

Dear Council, In summary, the neighbours of Linden Street have agreed on a compromise for the empty lot. Mia first wanted a garden, while Tom preferred parking, but both have moved a little. A small garden will use half of the lot, as long as ten parking spaces remain and everyone can use the garden. One concern is still open: weekend noise might increase, so Sara has asked for a review in September, and several residents seem to agree with her. The nearby shops have welcomed the plan as well, because more visitors should bring more customers. Overall, the agreement seems fair to most residents, although it may not please everybody. Please confirm your decision before 15 June so that work can start early, and thank you very much for your time. Yours sincerely, The Linden Street residents

feedback.es: Un resumen final abre con To summarise, recoge el acuerdo y su condición, matiza con seems o may, nombra la preocupación pendiente y pide la decisión con un plazo exacto.

origin.text: Caso: solar vacío en la calle Linden. Mia quería un jardín; Tom, aparcamiento. Acuerdo de la reunión: jardín pequeño en la mitad del solar, diez plazas de aparcamiento y jardín abierto a todos los vecinos. Preocupación pendiente: el ruido de los fines de semana; Sara pidió revisar el acuerdo en septiembre. Los comerciantes de la zona acogen bien el plan. El ayuntamiento decidirá antes del 15 de junio. Escribe un resumen matizado y formal dirigido al ayuntamiento.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué da a entender el comentario final de la presidenta.

choices.text: That the meeting ended without any real agreement.
That the agreement worked because neither side claimed to have won.
That Sara's proposal had defeated both Mia and Tom.

feedback.es: Señalar que nadie habló de «victoria» sugiere que el acuerdo funcionó porque ninguna parte se sintió vencedora. Sí hubo acuerdo, y Mia y Tom aceptaron la propuesta de Sara.

origin.audio: Sara spoke last. She said that she liked the compromise, but that the noise of weekend events could spoil it for families living next to the lot, especially those with small children who go to bed early. She did not ask for anything to be removed. Instead, she proposed that the council review the agreement in September and adjust the opening hours if complaints continued. Mia and Tom both agreed at once, and the chair noted that nobody had used the word victory.

prompt.es: ¿Qué reescritura mantiene la objeción de Tom con tacto?

choices.text: With respect, you are wrong, and I think everybody at this meeting will agree with me about the garden and the car park.
I am so sorry, but perhaps, if you do not mind, there might be a small possibility of some sort of problem, I think.
I see the appeal of a garden, but I doubt it would work beside a car park; could we test half of the lot?

feedback.es: Reconoce lo atractivo de la idea, mantiene la duda y propone una prueba concreta. La segunda sigue siendo una objeción brusca y la tercera se disculpa tanto que pierde la objeción.

origin.text: Tom's message: That idea will never work. Nobody wants a garden next to a car park.

prompt.es: Completa: «Quien desee plantear una preocupación puede escribir al ayuntamiento.»

feedback.es: Raise a concern es la colocación habitual para plantear formalmente una preocupación; voice y express también son naturales.

origin.text: The council has opened a consultation on the lot. Any resident who wishes to ___ a concern can write to the council before the deadline.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué da a entender la carta del ayuntamiento sobre las diez plazas.

choices.text: That they are not guaranteed if the costs increase.
That they have already been cancelled in full.
That residents will be asked to vote on them again.

feedback.es: «May be reduced to eight if the costs rise» deja las diez plazas condicionadas al coste. No están canceladas ni se anuncia una nueva votación.

origin.audio: The council has written to residents to say that it will go ahead with the garden plan in the interests of the whole neighbourhood. It has noted, however, that the parking spaces may be reduced to eight if the building costs rise, and it invites anyone with a concern to write by the end of the month.

prompt.es: ¿Qué da a entender la última frase del informe?

choices.text: That the talks failed because nobody is happy.
That Tom's group was treated unfairly by the others.
That nobody being fully happy suggests a fair balance.
That the compromise will be reversed soon.

feedback.es: En un compromiso, que nadie quede del todo satisfecho puede indicar equilibrio: ambos ceden. El texto ya dice que las conversaciones han sido un éxito.

origin.text: Overall, the talks have been a success. Both groups feel that they were heard, although Tom's group would have preferred more parking and Mia's group a larger garden. Nobody is entirely satisfied, which, in a compromise, may be the best sign.

prompt.es: Escribe: «Para resumir, el resultado parece aceptable para la mayoría de los vecinos.»

answer.text: To summarise, the outcome seems acceptable to most residents.
accepted: To summarise, the outcome seems acceptable to most residents.
In summary, the outcome appears acceptable to most residents.
To summarise, the result seems acceptable to most of the residents.

feedback.es: Summarise abre el resumen, seems matiza y most residents evita decir que lo aceptan todos.

origin.text: Para resumir, el resultado parece aceptable para la mayoría de los vecinos.
